renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: By this mere known, all powers know; kin to the sakini clan he may be, even without yoga. Rite-blind but rule-wise, he turns to worship — time-fire made from the first, through maya's end, gone to the brahma-body.

Siva, endless every way, deemed the supreme power-triad; whatever stands on the pure path dwells inside that. The atom soon attains pure lordly knowing; its driver is Siva to be known, all-knowing highest Lord. All-going, stainless, clear, full, self-homed, bright — like the great power-formed tree standing in the banyan seed.

So this moving-still world stands in the heart-seed; who knows it truly — his is the freedom-going. Initiation, free of sesame-ghee flame, undoubted comes — on crown, face, heart, secret, form, and so. Placing done, topknot bound twenty-seven-muttered; let the ten quarters' binding be yoked.
Three claps first, sounded to clear blocks; with topknot-count thrice-told, then sprinkle water.
